full_year_2026.source: Marriott FY2026 guidance (Feb 10, 2026 earnings call), MarketBeat, DefenseWorld

bull_bear_summary.bull_case: 1) Franchise moat: 20-50yr management agreements lock prime locations, high switching costs for hotel owners. 2) Bonvoy loyalty: 271M members, >50% of global room nights, network effects + co-branded credit card fees projected +35% in 2026. 3) Asset-light model: <2% room ownership, high ROIC, consistent cash flow. 4) Record pipeline: 610K rooms in pipeline, 4.5-5% net rooms growth. 5) Luxury demand: record 114 luxury deals signed in 2025 ('insatiable demand'). 6) Fee revenue re-rating: market re-pricing MAR from hotelier to fee-generating loyalty/fintech platform.
bull_bear_summary.bear_case: 1) Valuation stretched: P/E 34.2x vs industry avg 23.4x and peer avg 30.8x; intrinsic value estimates range $190-$285 vs $314 current. 2) Organic net unit growth lags Hilton — key driver of valuation discount. 3) Rising labor/wage costs squeezing margins as pricing power cools. 4) Macro risk: weak North American demand, potential consumer pullback. 5) Solvency score 45/100 (Simply Wall St). 6) Q4 2025 EPS miss (-1.15%) despite revenue beat — execution noise.
bull_bear_summary.source: Insider Monkey, Yahoo Finance, Simply Wall St, Alpha Spread, TIKR
